label: QKI::NTRK2

sections.text: QKI encodes an RNA-binding protein that regulates RNA processing and myelination.
NTRK2 encodes TRKB, a receptor tyrosine kinase for brain-derived neurotrophic factor and neurotrophin-4.
The fusion retains the NTRK2/TRKB kinase region and replaces normal receptor regulation with an amino-terminal partner. QKI::NTRK2 has been reported in pilocytic astrocytoma.

An expressed oncogenic NTRK fusion is a TRK-inhibitor biomarker in qualifying advanced solid tumors; larotrectinib criteria include prior progression or no satisfactory alternatives and absence of known acquired TRK resistance mutations.
